description: This file is a command-line tool for generating and displaying Kubernetes feature gate information in JSON or markdown format. It processes feature specifications, versions, stages, dependencies, and outputs formatted reports with sorting and filtering options.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that parses flags, generates output in JSON or markdown, and writes to stdout or file.

methods.name: generateJSON
methods.description: Generates a JSON report of all feature gates with their stages, dependencies, and version ranges, applying optional stage filtering.

methods.name: generateMarkdown
methods.description: Generates a markdown report of feature gates with detailed stage ranges, dependencies, and links, applying sorting and filtering.

methods.name: getPreviousMinorVersion
methods.description: Returns the previous minor version string given a version string.

methods.name: deduplicateStages
methods.description: Merges consecutive stage entries with identical stage, default, and locked values to produce compact version ranges.

methods.name: sortFeatures
methods.description: Sorts feature info list based on specified criteria: name, stage, alpha, beta, ga, deprecated, with optional reverse order.

methods.name: compareVersions
methods.description: Compares two version objects, handling nils, for sorting purposes.

methods.name: formatEnabledColumn
methods.description: Formats the Enabled column with icon and version when feature was first enabled.

methods.name: formatLockedColumn
methods.description: Formats the Locked column with icon and version when feature was first locked.

methods.name: formatStageRanges
methods.description: Formats stage range lists into markdown-compatible strings with en-dash ranges.
